pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: main 2-story block, short N-S ridge near x=545; big lit east face; north face shallow

pieces.name: west_cross
pieces.notes: cross hip on the west half, ridge E-W near y=497 meeting the main ridge; bright south face below it

pieces.name: nw_wing
pieces.notes: 1-story garage wing NW, ridge E-W; its south face sits in the main block shadow (dark V)

pieces.name: east_dormer
pieces.notes: small hip dormer/bump on the east face, ridge E-W; the dark triangle is its north face

exclude_notes: dark ground between the garage wing and main, trace overshoots
ground west of main below the garage eave
tree shadow and walkway south of the eave; eave at about y=646
notes: Main hip with a west cross hip, NW garage hip, and an east hip dormer. Confidence medium-high; the 25 deg NE hip line means unequal pitches.
